rules.value: FICTIONAL SAMPLE: Northstar Botanics is a demonstration skincare brand. All products, prices and claims in this guideline are invented for prototype testing, not real company facts.
Cloudberry Daily Cleanser 150ml costs INR 799, effective 1 January 2026.
A gentle rinse-off cleanser that removes surface oil.
No clinical trial results, medical treatment claims, guaranteed outcomes or competitor rankings are approved in this fictional sample.
Write in a calm, clear and helpful voice. Use short sentences and specific wording. Avoid fear, exaggerated promises, shouting and unnecessary urgency.
Results vary. Read the product label before use.
Use a concise caption, one clear call to action and at most three relevant hashtags.

Use descriptive link labels and plain language. Do not communicate essential meaning through emoji or colour alone. Supply meaningful alt text for informative images; image appearance requires human inspection.

Manual visual reference: teal #167569, ink #162841 on a light background, legible sans-serif type. Keep the wordmark proportional and readable; do not stretch it or use a busy background. Appearance requires human inspection.
